 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vikas Mahajan
 Order
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 CrPC seeking following relief:-
a. Quash the F.I.R. no. 314/2023 dated 14.08.2023 U/s 377/498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, registered with Police Station Kishangarh, Delhi and consequential proceedings emanating therefrom.
4.
Issue notice.
The learned APP for the State accepts notice.
5. Mr. Akash Vajapai, appearing on advance service accepts notice on behalf of the respondent no.2.
